answer: An attacker running many fake identities pays full stake per identity, so costs scale linearly while rewards stay bounded by a fixed island of reputation slots. Sybil resistance can use a staked proof-of-pulse: each agent locks collateral and must emit a verifiable liveness signal every epoch. Any identity that misses its pulse or hides past the challenge horizon forfeits stake, making mass fake accounts economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0001's threat model.
